summary: Dampskibsselskabet Norden A/S, a shipping company, owns and operates dry cargo and tanker vessels worldwide. It operates through the Dry operator  large vessels, Dry operator  small vessels, Tanker operator, Dry owner, Tanker owner, and Logistics segments. The company offers ocean- and port-based freight services for bulk cargo, such as agricultural, ores, minerals, and coal; project cargo, including windmill, components, machinery, steel, and forestry products; and liquid bulk, such as diesel, gasoline, jet fuel, and soft oil. Its fleet includes owned and leased vessels, externally chartered tonnage, and its tanker pool. Dampskibsselskabet Norden A/S was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark.
